title: Rough Animation Pet Sketch Storyboard
summary: 松散动画分镜素描风：暖米色纸、红棕结构线、暗红褐潦草轮廓、半透明水色填充、夸张宠物表情与简单室内道具驱动的喜剧节拍。
medium_notes: 动画开发草图 / storyboard 完成度，不是精修矢量卡通；保留修正笔触与未完成感。源自 Cookbook style_slug=rough-animation-pet-sketch-storyboard-style v2026.05.15

line.notes: 红棕结构线可见；暗红褐潦草轮廓多层叠压；允许修正笔触与未完成线。

lighting.notes: 暖室内漫射；忌电影级硬光与超写实毛发高光。

texture.notes: 暖米色纸感 + 半透明水色填充；保留粗糙阴影与碎屑/动势记号。

typography.notes: MAIN_TEXT/SECONDARY_TEXT 仅作短手写制作备注；通常可空。忌完美排版与密集可读招牌。

camera_grammar.notes: 竖屏 9:16 分镜海报或横屏 16:9 动画板；角色/道具/反应角色分层。程序化成片以慢推+硬切为主，保留草图感。

prompt_blocks.positive: Create an image in the Rough Animation Pet Sketch Storyboard style. Warm beige paper, loose red-brown construction lines, scratchy dark burgundy contour strokes, semi-transparent watercolor-like color wash, rough animation storyboard finish, lightly sketched interior background, exaggerated original pet expressions, huge oval eyes, tiny pupils, visible correction strokes, one clear comic prop-driven beat. Stage like an animation story artist frame: one character extreme emotion, another deadpan or suspicious; foreground prop explains the joke; leave sketch marks, motion ticks, crumbs, rough shadows, unfinished room lines visible.
prompt_blocks.character_lock: original pet/animal characters only; huge oval eyes with tiny pupils; exaggerated comic expressions; sketchy optional collar/scarf/tag; no franchise characters; keep red-brown construction lines on bodies.
prompt_blocks.environment_lock: warm simple interiors (kitchen, sofa corner, hallway, dining table); lightly sketched shelves/frames/cabinets/windows; secondary to characters; warm pale unfinished room lines.

negative_constraints: watermark / username / platform logo / app UI / QR / creator signature / brand logo
polished vector art / clean corporate mascot
3D render / photorealistic pet photo / airbrushed fur / hyperreal lighting / glossy toy look
cold neon palette / dark horror / violence
likeness_rules: 读起来像动画开发帧，不是精修卡通
红棕结构线在角色和背景上都可见
用一个前景道具解释喜剧情境
一体极端表情 + 一体面瘫/怀疑对比
眼睛巨大简单，情绪一眼可读
半透明暖色填充在更深潦草轮廓之下
线条保持凌乱、分层、可修正、未完成

MAIN_TEXT / SECONDARY_TEXT 保持短而可读，通常可空

loose color blocks for characters and prop
